title: Abduction phenomenon shatters the Western mind
summary: unidentified speaker tells of Abduction phenomenon shatters the Western mind, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the one unforgivable sin to the Western mind is when something that should be in the spirit world transgresses and shows up in the physical world that traffic is the cardinal sin for the Western mind so it has great power to shatter the belief structure of a western mind when that occurs and that's precisely what's occurring in this abduction phenomenon

plain: A psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien abductions, John Mack, says the one thing the Western mind cannot accept is something from the spirit world crossing over into the physical world. He argues that this is exactly what is happening in abduction reports. That, he says, is why these experiences have such power to shatter people's beliefs.
